login.codeDesc: We have sent a code to your other devices.

language.title: @:lng_settings_language
language.desc: Official Telegram/TDLib language packs. Selecting a pack downloads and caches it; updates arrive via UpdateLanguagePackStrings. t.me/setlanguage/* links in messages can add packs directly.

settingsList.devOptionsDesc: TDLib methods, update log, developer tools
settingsList.devOnHint: Developer options enabled (click 5 times to disable)
settingsList.devOffHint: Click 5 times to enable developer options

systemSettings.title: System Settings
systemSettings.connectionDesc: Active connection parameters (read-only). To change them, use the settings button on the login page when adding a new account.
systemSettings.accountsDesc: Sign in to multiple accounts and switch between them.
systemSettings.addDialogDesc: Sign in to another Telegram account. Multiple accounts can coexist and switch anytime.
systemSettings.getApiHint: Get your API ID and API Hash from {link}.
systemSettings.enterApiCreds: Enter API ID and API Hash
systemSettings.apiIdInvalid: API ID must be a positive integer

editProfile.phoneChangeHint: Change phone number in the official app
editProfile.personalChannelHint: Shown at the top of your profile page
editProfile.personalChatPick: Choose a channel to show at the top of your profile
editProfile.chatbotNotSupported: Adding or changing chatbots is not supported yet.
editProfile.chatbotUseOfficial: Please use the official Telegram app.

appearance.previewIncoming: This is a preview of a message from someone else
appearance.previewOutgoing: This is a preview of a message you sent
appearance.previewChatListDesc: Preview of avatar corner radius and sender mini avatar.
appearance.cornerRadiusSymmetricalDesc: When off, the side facing the avatar uses a smaller radius; when on, all four corners use Message corner radius
appearance.fontSizeDesc: Controls the text size inside messages
appearance.messageScaleDesc: Scale message bubbles overall (including spacing and text)
appearance.hideStickerTimestampDesc: When on, the small time pill at the bottom-right of stickers is hidden
appearance.botCommandInsertDesc: Clicking commands like /start inserts them at the start of the input (space-separated) instead of sending
appearance.chatWallpaperDesc: Solid colors, patterns, and installed image wallpapers
appearance.translateDesc: Choose how translated text appears after clicking Translate in the message context menu.
appearance.translatePopupDesc: Show the translation in a separate popup; target language can be switched
appearance.translateInlineDesc: Show the translation inside the message bubble; can be removed anytime
appearance.folderOptionsDesc: Control whether unread counts and folder icons appear in the folder bar above the chat list.
appearance.avatarRadiusDesc: 0 = square, 100 = circle (including avatars next to messages)
appearance.forumAvatarFollowsRadiusDesc: When on, forum group avatars use the radius above; when off, they use a small square radius
appearance.senderMiniAvatar: Show sender mini avatar before last message
appearance.badgeOnLeft: Show unread badge on the left
appearance.loaderStyleDesc: Pick your preferred loading progress style for the chat list, image/video loading, and more.
appearance.loaderSelectedHint: The selected item shows at 55% progress; during download progress updates live with {file}.
appearance.headerAvatarDesc: Choose where the avatar and name appear in a chat.
appearance.navSidebarDesc: Avatar in the side navigation bar
appearance.titlebarDesc: Avatar in the window title bar

notificationSettings.previewDesc: Live preview of the system notification popup; the switches below apply immediately.
notificationSettings.whenDesc: Control when system notifications appear, without changing popup styling.
notificationSettings.desktopNotifyDesc: Show a system notification when a new message arrives
notificationSettings.whenAppFocusedDesc: When off, notifications only appear if the window is unfocused or minimized
notificationSettings.sampleGroupBody: Hello everyone, this is a group message preview
notificationSettings.notifDisabledDesc: System notifications will not appear while disabled

proxy.autoFollowSystemDesc: Use system proxy when enabled, direct when disabled
proxy.disableDirectDesc: Connect to Telegram servers directly, without any proxy
proxy.systemProxyMissing: No system proxy detected; will fall back to direct connection
proxy.useFromListDesc: Pick one from the proxy list below
proxy.notSelected: No proxy selected. Choose one from the list below.
proxy.emptyListHint: Click "Add proxy" in the top right, or click a proxy.t.me link to add one.
proxy.shareUnavailable: Cannot generate a share link for this proxy

download.enableAutoDesc: When off, media files are never downloaded automatically
download.photoDesc: Video covers, images, stickers, audio covers, etc.
download.videoDesc: Auto-download videos smaller than the size limit
download.fileDesc: Auto-download documents smaller than the size limit
download.autoDisabledHint: Auto-download is off; tap the download button to fetch media manually.
download.appdataDesc: Data is stored in the system user directory; uninstalling or moving the app does not affect it
download.portableDesc: Data is stored inside the app directory and moves with the app
download.switchHint: Switching location closes TDLib and moves data; the app restarts automatically when done.
download.migratingHint: TDLib is closed and data is moved during migration; the app restarts automatically when done.
download.migrateToAppdata: Migrate back to system data directory (AppData)

wallpaper.title: Chat wallpaper
wallpaper.defaultDesc: When a chat has no custom background, new chats use this wallpaper.
wallpaper.overlayDesc: Reduces wallpaper interference with messages and UI
wallpaper.addDesc: Pick an image file from this device as wallpaper
wallpaper.darkMode: Use dark wallpaper in dark mode
wallpaper.darkModeDesc: Reloads the matching installed wallpaper after switching
wallpaper.noHdFile: This wallpaper has no full-resolution file
wallpaper.stillDownloading: Full-resolution wallpaper is still downloading; try again later

dev.title: Developer options
dev.sendTdlibDesc: Paste a JSON request (e.g. {'{'}"_":"getMe"{'}'}) or type a method name (e.g. getMe). Results print to the console. Use with care.
dev.logUpdatesDesc: Log updates to the console and show recent tdlib-update entries below
dev.waitingUpdate: Waiting for update events… (they appear after interacting with Telegram)
dev.showCopyJsonDesc: Show "Copy chat/message raw JSON" debug items in chat list and message context menus
dev.crashLogDesc: Records global errors, unhandled promises, bootstrap failures, and #app cleared events (localStorage: tdgram-crash-log)
dev.openDevtoolsDesc: Open the frontend F12 developer tools

privacy.alreadyInList: This user or group is already in the list

avatar.supportedFormats: Supports JPG / PNG / WEBP and other formats
avatar.dragHint: Drag the image to reposition; use the slider to zoom
avatar.imageLoadFailedHint: Failed to load image; try another one

secretChat.encryptionKeyDesc: This is the visual representation of the encryption key of your secret chat with {name}.
